The reference temperature, pressure and phase of a reference state have no column attribute.
- `close` Constraint and Variable (ConstraintVariableType): constraint_has_constant requires a column constant, but the uncertainty, digits and repeatability of a constraint have no column attribute and would have to be repeated as datum records; composition bases that are not declared (mass concentration, ratios to solvent, per mass of solution, initial and final compositions of a mixing or dissolution experiment) and the Upper and Lower temperature and pressure names (interval endpoints) have no model member.
- `close` NumValues (VariableValue and PropertyValue): datum holds one uncertainty per (point, column): ThermoML allows several assessments plus combined, repeatability, device and curve-deviation entries per value. Asymmetric uncertainties (two magnitudes) have no member; uncertainty_kind has no repeatability, device_specification, combined or curve_deviation member. A limit gives datum_state censored but the model does not say whether it is an upper or a lower bound. Digits map exactly to datum.digits.
- `close` Uncertainty, repeatability, device-specification and curve-deviation definitions: The model carries the kind and magnitude on each datum but not the evaluator, the method, the level of confidence, the repeatability statistic, the device-specification basis or the curve; asymmetric, repeatability, device, combined and curve-deviation entries are not members of uncertainty_kind; relative uncertainty appears only as nCurveRmsRelativeDevValue.
- `close` CriticalEvaluation and Prediction (method alternatives of a property): The dataset kind is implied by the element rather than declared; ePredictionType has no model vocabulary; the evaluation description is free text.
- `broader` Equation (equation representation part of a dataset): The forms named here (Antoine, Wagner variants, polynomial expansion, the two Span-Wagner-type equations of state, two Helmholtz generals, CustomExpansion) must exist in the form catalogue for a mapping to populate slots; the schema does not define them, so slot meaning depends on the URL content. Off-diagonal covariance has no model home (slot_uncertainty has a magnitude per slot; covariance belongs to the fit).
- `close` ReactionData: reaction.canonical_key needs coefficients, which are optional and whose sign is unstated; per-participant composition and phase are conditions of the measured state, not part of the reaction; eReactionType, eReactionFormalism (chemical versus biochemical, with transformed properties) and nElectronNumber have no attribute.
- `close` Solvent and Catalyst: The solvent of a property is a per-property reference in ThermoML while dataset_component.function is per dataset; a dataset whose properties name different solvents needs several components or datasets.
- `unmapped` Biomaterial extensions: The model has no conformational state of a macromolecule, no transformed (apparent) thermodynamic quantity at fixed pH and ionic strength, and no pH or pC quantity types.
- `exact` Unit embedded in enumeration strings: Factors to storage units: kPa to Pa (1000), kJ/mol to J/mol (1000), mol/dm3 to mol/m3 (1000), kg/kmol to kg/mol (0.001), J/g to J/kg (1000). The units with a symbolic exponent n cannot be converted to a fixed quantity type. Units with no quantity type in physical.toml include 1/kPa, 1/K, kPa/K, K/kPa, J/kPa/mol, J/K/m3, m3/kg, m6/mol2, S/m, S*m2/mol, V, m/s, nm, MHz, 1/Pa/s, kg/mol/K, kPa*kg/mol, kPa*dm3/mol and kJ (extensive energy).
- `exact` Integer cross-references (nCompIndex, RegNum, nSampleNm, nPropNumber, nVarNumber, nConstraintNumber, nUncertAssessNum): Resolution errors (an undefined index) are not caught by the schema and must be checked by the mapping.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup Criticals): The names do not say pure or mixture: the subject follows from the number of Component elements of the dataset, so critical_temperature (subject pure) cannot hold a mixture critical point. Critical density in kg/m3 needs MassDensity with basis none, critical specific volume needs a specific-volume quantity type that physical.toml lacks, and lower versus upper consolute has no facet (path and relation have no member).
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup Criticals): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup VaporPBoilingTAzeotropTandP): vapor_pressure is declared for vapour-liquid equilibrium whereas ThermoML uses one name for vapour pressure and sublimation pressure and separates them only by PropPhaseID (gas with liquid or crystal); normal boiling temperature, boiling temperature and the two azeotropic quantities have no declared observable; the 101.325 kPa of the normal boiling point appears only in a documentation element of the enumeration value.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup VaporPBoilingTAzeotropTandP): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup PhaseTransition): "Molar enthalpy of transition or fusion" and "of vaporization or sublimation" each merge processes that only PropPhaseID distinguishes; path has no member for a solid-liquid or liquid-liquid coexistence line (saturation is documented as a saturation line); there is no facet for the kind of invariant point (triple, quadruple, eutectic, peritectic, monotectic); no quantity types exist for 1/K and kg/mol/K (cryoscopic constants); the lattice energy at 0 K is relative to an implicit gas-phase reference the name does not state.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup PhaseTransition): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup CompositionAtPhaseEquilibrium): composition_basis has no member for mass concentration (kg/m3), amount, mass or volume ratio of solute to solvent, or amount of solute per mass of solution (mol/kg), nor for the qualifier "in LLG critical state"; the kind of equilibrium (solubility, LLE, VLE) is implied by the dataset phases and has no facet; Henry constants carry a composition scale in their names (mole fraction, molality, amount concentration), for which an observable needs a facet, and the quantity types Pressure per molality and Pressure per molarity are absent.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup CompositionAtPhaseEquilibrium): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup ActivityFugacityOsmoticProp): The activity-coefficient convention (symmetric or asymmetric, composition scale) is not an element; only eStandardState implies it, and "Pure compound" does not say whether the state is a real liquid or an ideal gas (pure_real versus pure_ideal_gas) or at what pressure; "Mean ionic activity, (mol/dm3)^n" has a unit that depends on the stoichiometric exponent n, which a Scalar cannot carry.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup ActivityFugacityOsmoticProp): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup VolumetricProp): Missing quantity types: specific volume, third virial coefficient (m6/mol2), compressibility (1/Pa), expansion coefficient (1/K), pressure per temperature. subject_shape has no member for the ternary subject of the interaction virial coefficients C112 and C122; no facet separates acoustic virial coefficients from pressure-series ones; "Relative partial molar volume" needs a relation member "relative to a reference state" that reference_relation lacks (closest: increment); the compressibility factor is a ratio to the ideal-gas value and has no relation member.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup VolumetricProp): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup HeatCapacityAndDerivedProp): The schema states no energy datum, so dataset.convention_set must stay absent for "Molar enthalpy" and "Molar entropy"; the reference temperature of the enthalpy and Gibbs-energy functions (0 K or 298.15 K) is text inside the name, making separate observables instead of a facet; path has no isenthalpic member (Joule-Thomson) and there are no quantity types for J/K/m3, K/kPa and J/kPa/mol; cp/cv is a ratio of two observables with no facet.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup HeatCapacityAndDerivedProp): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup ExcessPartialApparentEnergyProp): "Excess molar enthalpy (molar enthalpy of mixing)" fuses excess and mixing, which coincide for enthalpy only; "per mol of mixture" versus "per mol of solute" (documented on the values) cannot be expressed by amount_basis; relative partial molar quantities lack a relation member; enthalpies of solution and dilution are differences between states given by initial and final composition variables and look like plain increments without them; the declared standard_molar_* observables have subject pure whereas these describe a solute in a solvent.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup ExcessPartialApparentEnergyProp): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup TransportProp): The frame of "Binary diffusion coefficient" is not stated and diffusion_frame has no member for unstated (not_applicable means not a diffusion observable); self and tracer diffusion merge into self_diffusion; quantity types are missing for kinematic viscosity and thermal diffusivity (same dimensions as Diffusivity but a different meaning), fluidity, electrical conductivity and molar conductivity.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup TransportProp): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup RefractionSurfaceTensionSoundSpeed): "Refractive index (Na D-line)" fixes a wavelength by name while "(other wavelength)" takes it from a Variable; complex relative permittivity is two names (real part, imaginary part) with no part facet; excess refractive index and excess speed of sound use an excess relation against an ideal mixing rule the schema does not state; no quantity type for speed of sound.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup RefractionSurfaceTensionSoundSpeed): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (PropertyGroup BioProperties): eBioState is a conformational state, not an aggregation: dataset_phase.aggregation has no member for it; the kind of transition temperature (half conversion, peak, zero Gibbs energy) has no facet.
- `close` eMethodName (PropertyGroup BioProperties): dataset.method is free text, so the enumeration becomes text; the dataset kind is not declared in the schema and must be inferred from which alternative was chosen.
- `close` ePropName (ReactionData PropertyGroup ReactionStateChangeProp): Participant coefficients are optional floats with no stated sign convention (reaction_participant has signed coefficients and an extent_convention); "per mol of reaction" is not stated; "Specific internal energy of reaction, J/g" has a mass basis without saying per gram of what; "Enthalpy of process, kJ" is an extensive amount for which physical.toml has no Energy quantity; cell potential and nElectronNumber have no home.
- `close` eMethodName (ReactionData PropertyGroup ReactionStateChangeProp): several methods may be listed for one reaction property; dataset.method holds one text.
- `close` ePropName (ReactionData PropertyGroup ReactionEquilibriumProp): The declared observable has quantity Scalar; the molality, molarity and partial-pressure constants have unit (mol/kg)^n, (mol/dm3)^n and kPa^n with n the sum of the stoichiometric coefficients, which Scalar loses; there is no facet for the scale of a constant or for the logarithm base (ln K equals ln 10 times log10 K, K itself is non-linear).
- `close` eMethodName (ReactionData PropertyGroup ReactionEquilibriumProp): several methods may be listed for one reaction property; dataset.method holds one text.
- `unmapped` eType: no attribute in publication
- `unmapped` eSourceType: no attribute in publication
- `unmapped` eLanguage: no attribute in publication
- `unmapped` eSpeciationState: speciation_map describes apparent versus true species per chemical system, not a flag on a compound
- `narrower` eFunction (PureOrMixtureData AuxiliarySubstance): Buffer and Inert have no component_function member (closest: catalyst is "present but not a participant", not the same)
- `narrower` eFunction (ReactionData AuxiliarySubstance): Cofactor, Buffer and Inert have no component_function member
- `unmapped` eSampleStatus: sample has no status attribute
- `close` eSampleSource: a vocabulary becomes free text; "Standard Reference Material (SRM)" and "Isolated from a natural product" are not supplier names
- `unmapped` ePurifMethod: sample holds no purification history
- `unmapped` ePurityAnalMethod: sample holds no analytical method
- `unmapped` eExpPurpose: dataset has no purpose attribute; dataset.title or method could hold it as text
- `close` eCrystalLatticeTypeSelection: the seven lattice systems are coarser than a polymorph designation and the model declares no crystal-system vocabulary
- `unmapped` eBioState (PropPhaseID): aggregation has no conformational state; dataset_phase.label could hold the text
- `unmapped` MulticomponentType: defined_mixture has no kind attribute beyond mixture_definition
- `narrower` MulticomponentComposition: "number of molecules" is not a fraction; the Boolean cannot hold it
- `unmapped` eReactionFormalism: transformed (apparent) quantities of the biochemical formalism have no concept
- `unmapped` eReactionType: no reaction classification in the model
- `close` eCompositionRepresentation: the ratio bases, amount per mass of solution and mass per volume of solution have no composition_basis member, and the composition of a participant is a condition of the measured state, not part of the reaction
- `close` eParticipantAmount (constraint and variable type group): Amount and Mass quantity types exist but no observable is declared
- `close` ePredictionType: the eight types have no vocabulary in the model
- `close` eEqName: the forms must be declared in forms/ before slots can be populated; the schema defines no slot names
- `close` eTemperature (ConstraintVariableType): Upper and Lower temperature have no member: the model has no endpoint role for a variable column and ePresentation differences between upper and lower temperature depend on them.
- `close` ePressure (ConstraintVariableType): Partial pressure has no declared observable; upper and lower pressure have no endpoint member; absolute versus gauge pressure is not stated.
- `close` eComponentComposition (ConstraintVariableType): composition_basis lacks: ratio of amount, mass or volume of solute to solvent; mass of solute per volume of solution (kg/m3); amount of solute per mass of solution (mol/kg); and the qualifiers Initial and Final, which describe compositions before and after a mixing or dissolution process and need a process-state facet.
- `close` eSolventComposition (ConstraintVariableType): The "Solvent:" names describe the composition of the solvent mixture on a solute-free basis; the model has no notion of a sub-mixture whose components are a subset of the dataset components, and the bases are missing as for eComponentComposition.
- `close` eMiscellaneous (ConstraintVariableType): No quantity types for wavelength and frequency; a property name and a variable name coincide, so the role (constraint, variable, property) is the only thing that distinguishes a measured density from a density held as a condition.
- `unmapped` eBioVariables (ConstraintVariableType): no pH, pC or ionic-strength quantity types.
- `close` eDeviceSpecMethod: uncertainty_kind says what the magnitude means (standard, expanded, relative, interval, exact, not_stated); the method describes how it was obtained and whether it is biased, unbiased or of the mean, which the model cannot hold.
- `close` eRepeatMethod: uncertainty_kind says what the magnitude means (standard, expanded, relative, interval, exact, not_stated); the method describes how it was obtained and whether it is biased, unbiased or of the mean, which the model cannot hold.
- `close` eCombUncertEvalMethod: uncertainty_kind says what the magnitude means (standard, expanded, relative, interval, exact, not_stated); the method describes how it was obtained and whether it is biased, unbiased or of the mean, which the model cannot hold.
- `close` eStandardState: The standard pressure (pressure_rule fixed, system_pressure or saturation) is not stated for any value, so pressure_rule cannot be filled without an assumption; standard_state_kind has no unspecified member; the solvent of an infinite-dilution state comes from the Solvent element of the property, which is separate and optional; "Pure compound" does not distinguish real from ideal gas.
- `close` ePhaseName: aggregation has no member for liquid crystals (smectic, nematic, cholesteric: seven values); "Solution" is a liquid with a solvent convention (the model deliberately has no aqueous aggregation); "Crystal of intercomponent compound n" names a crystalline solid whose composition is a compound of the components, which needs an entity, not an aggregation; "Metastable crystal" states a stability that has no attribute; "Ideal gas" is a model state rather than an observed phase and "Air at 1 atmosphere" is a reference medium (gas of stated composition and pressure) used for refractive index, which is not a phase of the system; the eCrystalLatticeTypeSelection companion has only lattice systems.
- `narrower` ePresentation: reference_relation has no member for a ratio to a reference state, a relative difference to a reference state, a temperature-interval difference or a mean between two temperatures; these change the quantity (a ratio is dimensionless, a difference over an interval needs two condition values) and would have to be separate observables with no facet that derives them, or be converted by the mapping to direct values where the reference value is known.
- `close` eRefStateType: reference_relation is an enumeration without parameters: it cannot carry the reference phase, the fixed temperature and pressure or the choice between "same" and "fixed" state point; residual_tp has no ThermoML counterpart and the constant-volume ideal-mixture state is only approximated by excess; the pure solvent or solute reference states are increments without stated states.

### thermopack (35)

- `close` fluid record (identity block): The five hydrogen entries carry one structure but are distinct components (nuclear-spin isomer or equilibrium composition): the model's species identity has no spin-state attribute, so they need separate species or a declared discriminator; the InChI is written without prefix and is not an InChIKey; placeholders for PSEUDO and LJF must not be imported as identifiers.
- `close` structure (element count string): Deuterium as a separate element needs a declared element entity that the model's element list (chemical elements only) does not contain; the string is the only composition record and it duplicates formula without a stated consistency rule.
- `close` critical (critical point block): Values are carried as a bundle with one ref tag per block, and the Fortran module re-prints Tc with 4 decimals and Pc with 2, so the authored precision is lost downstream; a consumer cannot tell whether a run used these constants or the model-derived replacements.
- `close` acentric_factor: Zero cannot be told from not applicable; attribution is missing for 95 percent of records.
- `close` boiling_temperature: The pressure of the boiling point (normal) is implicit; zero stands for unavailable.
- `close` triple (triple point block): The zero sentinel must be converted to an absent value; melting and sublimation curves also carry a triple_temperature that is a second, separate statement of the same quantity.
- `close` rackett_factor: The same quantity also yields an estimated volume shift in code; the derivation (and its SRK and PR constants 0.40768, 0.29441, 0.50033, 0.25969) lives only in volume_shift.f90.
- `close` dipole_moment and quadrupole_moment: Quadrupole needs a new quantity type (unit Angstrom*Debye is not SI-coherent); the same moments reappear inside some PC-SAFT sets (mu in 2 sets, Q in 6 sets) with their own attribution.
- `close` reference_state (enthalpy and entropy of formation data): The gas-phase (ideal gas) state of the formation enthalpy is implied, not stated; the element reference entropies are a separate table in a script (not data); 1e20 dummies and 0 entropy must become absent, and gref (computed, not read at run time) is a derivation with its own lineage.
- `unmapped` gendatadb (generated pure-component record): Importing both would duplicate each fact; the Fortran image must be treated as a rendering of the JSON (they agree on every compared value) and only the JSON carries the authored precision and attribution.
- `close` saturation (vapour-pressure estimate block): Antoine constants here are in ln(mmHg) form and are not used by any solver; Michelsen and Starling estimates have no parameters (they are procedures on Tc, Pc, acf, Zc).
- `broader` ideal_heat_capacity-N (ideal-gas heat capacity correlation set): One JSON array holds thirteen differently-shaped coefficient lists; the id selects form, units (mass or molar), basis and whether Tmin and Tmax are Celsius; they must be split into distinct forms and converted using the molar mass, and the positional meaning (especially the Einstein pairs and the zero padding) has to be recovered from code. The two hydrogen special ids (10 and 13) and id 100 have no data representation.
- `broader` PR and SRK container blocks: The container mixes four unrelated slot groups under the eos key and encodes set identity in key suffixes (TWU-1, TWU-2) that are arbitrary; identity must come from the ref tag instead.
- `close` alpha correlation set (TWU and MC): Identity lives in (eos, ref) rather than in a subject pair; the 'Default' tag is attached to only some MC sets and to no TWU set, so a default cannot be read from the data (see selection); the c1..c3 roles must be fixed per form.
- `close` volume_shift (Peneloux volume translation set): The JSON stores only the first three coefficients although the code supports six; correlation is an order tag, not a meaning; the Rackett fallback is a derivation that produces a parameter at run time.
- `close` CPA pure-component set: The scheme and the radial-distribution flag are model choices coupled to the set (a set is valid only under its scheme and RDF variant); the unit of a0 and b (litre-based) differs from the SI storage units of the model's quantity types.
- `close` PC-SAFT pure-component set: eps embeds a gas-constant value (a convention_set property) in a stored number; the model has a separate EnergyTemperature type and no quadrupole type; the pi/6 ambiguity of beta is a convention that has to be recorded per parameterization.
- `close` SAFT-VR Mie pure-component set (including quantum variants): The fh_order slot and the model option must be kept consistent (dependency kind consistent_with); eps has different units under the same name in two model families; beta has no stated unit.
- `close` ref and bib_reference (parameter-set attribution pair): Several tags in one string name one set that belongs to several parameterisations (for example Rehner2020_2B/Aasen2024dft); the default marker is an in-band tag rather than a policy; behavioural tags (tcPR, QuantumCubic) are model switches disguised as parameter-set names.
- `close` melting_curve: Term types are encoded by count positions (n1, n2, n3) rather than by a per-term type tag; MP-1 has a different, piecewise form under the same field names (coeff and exponents mean something else there).
- `close` sublimation_curve: The H2S record with id S2 has no valid fourth character, so the Fortran id test would stop the program for that record (inferred); the two curve forms differ by one sign convention that is implicit.
- `narrower` binary kij record (cubic vdW mixing; PR, SRK, CSP-PR, CSP-SRK, PT files): A symmetric canonical orientation would merge orientation duplicates, but the source holds conflicting values for one pair under one ref (CO2/H2O: 0.074 and -0.065); duplicates with the same ref have no stated precedence (the code picks the last Default-tagged record, see selection).
- `close` Lee-Kesler binary kij record: The model-wide default of 1.0 is not in the data; the mixing meaning differs from the vdW kij (a multiplicative factor rather than 1 - kij).
- `narrower` binary lij record (cubic covolume interaction): lij is attached to the same pair but to a separate file and record type from kij; the two should be one slot group per (equation, reference).
- `close` binary excess-Gibbs mixing record (HV1, HV2, NRTL): One record carries both directions; the model's closed transposition rules (ordered, symmetric, parity, reciprocal, permutation_group) have no rule that swaps named slots on reversal, so the record must be split into two ordered rows; NA+ and CL- have no fluid record, so their identity cannot be resolved inside this source.
- `close` CPA cross-association and kij record: Combining rules are enumerations attached to the pair; attribution is absent.
- `close` PC-SAFT binary record: The key names uid1 and uid2 differ from the cubic files; the default combining rule is code, not data.
- `close` SAFT-VR Mie binary record (kij and lij): No gamma_ij (repulsive-exponent interaction) is bundled although the wrapper can set one; the FH-order coupling of the tag is implicit.
- `close` UNIFAC subgroup (unifacprm): Two rows may define the same group differently across sources (a commented alternative CO group sits in place); the file embeds no scheme revision, only source strings.
- `close` UNIFAC interaction row (unifacUij): Two parameterisations are interleaved in one table with overlapping keys, and only the first is reachable in code; missing pairs silently become zero rather than absent.
- `close` MBWR coefficient set (mbwr32Data, mbwr19Data): Set numbers exist without a selection rule; units are inferred from comments, not declared per value.
- `close` multiparameter Helmholtz parameters in code (propane, hydrogen isomers, R134a, Lennard-Jones): Values are compiled into code and carry no per-value reference; the gas constant of the fit and the library gas constant differ and the choice is a runtime switch.
- `close` solid equation parameters in code (CO2 dry ice and H2O ice Ih): The constants are code, not data; the gas constant 8.314472 differs from the library default.
- `unmapped` inline quantum-cubic and beta(T) parameters in code: The overrides are procedural and apply by reference-tag match; they replace data in the fluid record rather than adding a set, so a mapping must model them as a parameterization that supersedes constants.
- `close` pseudo-component record (PSEUDO): The placeholder values must not be imported as constants; only the existence of a user-parameterised pseudo-component is data.
